description: Search live Google web results for any query and country/language, returning ranked canonical organic results (position, title, direct URL, domain, snippet, favicon, sitelinks), native related_keywords array, People Also Ask (PAA) Q&A pairs, and Knowledge Graph. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1K queries; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

limit.description: Number of organic results to return (1–100, default 10).

q.description: Search query string, e.g. "best vector database for rag 2026" or "site:sec.gov nvidia 10-k".

name: google_search

knowledge_graph.description: Google Knowledge Graph card when present.

organic_results.description: Ranked Google organic web search results.

people_also_ask.description: Related People Also Ask Q&A entries.

meta.description: Response telemetry metadata including request_id, credit cost, cache hit flag, and latency.

cached.description: True when served from warm Redis/PostgreSQL cache.

count.description: Number of primary result items returned.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 4xx/5xx error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

title: Real-Time Google Search SERP, Related Keywords & People Also Ask
